shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "pwd && rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!package-lock.json'"' -g '"'!pnpm-lock.yaml'"' -g '"'!yarn.lock'"' -g '"'!*lock*'"' -g 'AGENTS.md' -g 'package.json' -g 'src/**' -g 'app/**' -g 'pages/**' -g '.agents/skills/gravity-ui/**' -g 'index.html' -g 'vite.config.*' -g 'tsconfig*' -g 'README*'"
/bin/bash -lc 'cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md'

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,100p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && rg -n -C 4 'chartkit|yagr|charts|icons' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && cat package.json src/App.tsx src/main.tsx && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md"

/bin/bash -lc 'ls -a && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/icons.md && cat tsconfig.json vite.config.ts && npm install @gravity-ui/chartkit @gravity-ui/charts @gravity-ui/yagr @gravity-ui/icons @gravity-ui/navigation'

/bin/bash -lc 'npm view @gravity-ui/chartkit version peerDependencies && npm view @gravity-ui/charts@1 version peerDependencies && npm view @gravity-ui/navigation@3 version peerDependencies && npm view @gravity-ui/yagr version peerDependencies'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm install @gravity-ui/chartkit@8 @gravity-ui/charts@1 @gravity-ui/yagr@5 @gravity-ui/icons@2 @gravity-ui/navigation@3 @bem-react/classname'

/bin/bash -lc "node -e \"for(const p of ['uikit','chartkit','charts','yagr','icons','navigation']) console.log(p,require('@gravity-ui/'+p+'/package.json').version)\" && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/README.md && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/README.md && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/README.md"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/README.md && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/README.md && rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit | head -45 && rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/components | rg '/(SegmentedRadioGroup|Select|Switch|Button|Modal|DropdownMenu)/.*d.ts"'$'"'"

/bin/bash -lc "node -e \"for(const p of ['uikit','chartkit','charts','yagr','icons','navigation']) console.log(p,JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('node_modules/@gravity-ui/'+p+'/package.json')).version)\" && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/README.md node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/docs/INDEX.md && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/README.md && sed -n '1,160p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/README.md"

/bin/bash -lc "rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit | rg '(SegmentedRadioGroup|Select|Switch|Button|Modal|DropdownMenu)/(.*d.ts|README.md)"'$'"' | head -45 && rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation | rg 'AsideHeader.*(d.ts|README.md)"'$'"' && rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/plugins | head -50 && rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons | rg '(Chart|Pulse|Arrow|Gear|Bell|House|Calendar|Database|CircleQuestion|Sliders|Magnifier|Layout|File|Square)' | head -75"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/plugins/{gravity-charts,yagr}/{index.js,types.d.ts} && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/components/ChartKit/ChartKit.d.ts && sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/types.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Switch/Switch.d.ts && sed -n '1,130p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Select/types.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist | rg '(line|axis|chart|series).*d.ts"'$'"' | head -25 && rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr | rg '(types|config).*d.ts"'$'"' | head -20 && rg -n 'color-base-(float|background|generic|positive)|color-text-(positive|info|secondary)|color-line-generic' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/themes/_light.scss | head -25 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/package.json | head -65"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/types/series/line.d.ts && rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/types | head -35 && sed -n '1,160p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/plugins/yagr/renderer/YagrWidget.js && rg -n 'interface|type |appearance|axes|scales|legend' node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/types.d.ts | head -55 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Modal/Modal.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,185p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/types.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Switch/Switch.d.ts && sed -n '1,125p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Select/types.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/types/widget.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm | rg '(series/line|axes/types|types/chart|types/series|types/axis|chart/types)' | head -35; rg -n 'interface (ChartData|LineSeries)|type (ChartData|LineSeries)' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm; sed -n '1,140p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/plugins/yagr/renderer/YagrWidget.js; rg -n 'interface|appearance|axes|scales|legend' node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/types.d.ts | head -45; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Modal/Modal.d.ts; rg -n -A 70 'interface (MenuItem|LogoProps)|type (MenuItem|LogoProps)' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/types.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '35,120p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/index.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/line.d.ts && sed -n '1,185p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/axis.d.ts && sed -n '1,95p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/chart.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/YagrCore/types.d.ts && sed -n '1,150p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/plugins/yagr/renderer/useWidgetData.js && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/types/index.d.ts && rg -n -- '--gn-aside|--gn-' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/AsideHeader.css | head -30 && rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons | rg '/(ChartLine|ChartColumn|Database|CircleQuestion|ArrowDownToLine|ArrowsRotateRight|ArrowUpRight|Gear|Bell|ChevronRight|ChevronDown|Calendar|Xmark|ArrowUpRightFromSquare|Heart|Bookmark|CircleCheck|Cloud|Moon|Sun|CircleInfo|Ellipsis|ArrowRight|ArrowsExpand).*d.ts"'$'"'"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,70p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/index.js; rg -n 'css|aside-header' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/AsideHeader.js | head -12; sed -n '185,235p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/YagrCore/types.d.ts; rg -n -A 25 'interface (Scale|AxisOptions)|type RawSerieData|interface CommonSeries' node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/YagrCore/types.d.ts; sed -n '180,230p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/axis.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/marker.d.ts | head -65; rg -n 'DashStyle' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/constants.d.ts; rg -n -- '--gn-aside' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build | head -12"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'useTheme|setTheme' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/*.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/hooks/*/*.d.ts | head -35; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/formatter.d.ts | head -100; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/libs/format-number/types.d.ts | head -100; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.css | head -100; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/package.json | head -90; cat index.html"

/bin/bash -lc "git status --short && rg -n 'useTheme' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/index.d.ts; rg -n 'shapeYagrConfig|timeMultiplier|graphs|timeline' node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/plugins/yagr/renderer/utils.js | head -30"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/useThemeSettings.d.ts && rg -n -A 24 'ThemeSettings' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/types.d.ts && rg -n -A 15 'option_checked' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.css | tail -30 && rg -n 'getComputedStyle|var\\(' node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/YagrCore/utils/*.js | head -12 && rg -n 'grid\\??|interface ChartAxisGrid|color\\??' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/axis.d.ts | head -20"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/ThemeSettingsContext.d.ts; sed -n '98,125p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.css; rg -n 'getComputedStyle|var\\(' node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/YagrCore/utils/*.js | head -12; rg -n 'grid\\??|interface ChartAxisGrid|color\\??' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/axis.d.ts | head -20"

/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('src/App.tsx')
s=p.read_text().replace('Text, useTheme, configure','Text, ThemeProvider, configure').replace(\"  const {theme, setTheme} = useTheme();\\n  const dark = theme === 'dark';\", '  const [dark, setDark] = useState(false);').replace('return <><div className=\"app-shell\">','return <ThemeProvider theme={dark ? \\'dark\\' : \\'light\\'}><div className=\"app-shell\">').replace(\"onUpdate={value => setTheme(value ? 'dark' : 'light')}\", 'onUpdate={setDark}').replace('  </>;\\n}', '  </ThemeProvider>;\\n}')
p.write_text(s)
p=Path('src/main.tsx'); s=p.read_text().replace(\"import {ThemeProvider} from '@gravity-ui/uikit';\\n\", '').replace('    <ThemeProvider theme=\"light\">\\n      <App />\\n    </ThemeProvider>', '    <App />'); p.write_text(s)
p=Path('src/VisualizationWidget.tsx'); s=p.read_text(); start=s.index('    const style ='); end=s.index(\"    if (mode === 'sales')\", start); s=s[:start]+\"    const primary = 'var(--g-color-text-brand)';\\n    const secondary = 'var(--app-chart-comparison)';\\n    const grid = 'var(--g-color-line-generic)';\\n    const text = 'var(--g-color-text-secondary)';\\n\"+s[end:]; s=s.replace(\"divisor: unit === '₽' ? 1000 : 1, suffix:\", \"multiplier: unit === '₽' ? 0.001 : 1, postfix:\"); p.write_text(s)
p=Path('src/styles.css'); s=p.read_text().replace('--g-color-text-brand: #785ddd;', '--g-color-text-brand: #785ddd;\\n  --g-color-text-brand-heavy: #654bc9;').replace('--g-color-text-brand: #b19cf8;', '--g-color-text-brand: #b19cf8;\\n  --g-color-text-brand-heavy: #c4b1ff;'); start=s.index('.mode-switch {'); end=s.index('\\n',start); s=s[:start]+'.mode-switch {--g-color-line-brand: var(--g-color-line-generic);}' +s[end:]; p.write_text(s)
p=Path('index.html'); s=p.read_text().replace('<title>Gravity UI eval</title>', '<meta name=\"theme-color\" content=\"#7860df\" />\\n    <meta name=\"description\" content=\"Pulse — продажи и мониторинг в одном аналитическом виджете.\" />\\n    <title>Pulse — Обзор аналитики</title>'); p.write_text(s)
PY
npm run build"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/YagrCore/utils/colors.js; sed -n '99,155p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/plugins/yagr/renderer/utils.js; rg -n -A 24 'ThemeProvider' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/ThemeProvider.js | head -55; sed -n '245,277p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/axis.d.ts; rg -n 'axis.*grid|grid.*stroke' node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/YagrCore/axes.js | head -20; cat .gitignore"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'getComputedStyle|startsWith.*var\\(|utils.colors.parse' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/utils/color* node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/YagrCore | head -25; rg -n 'var\\(--g-color' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/constants* | head -10; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/tooltip.d.ts | head -65; rg -n 'stroke.*parse|parse.*stroke' node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/YagrCore | head -15"

/bin/bash -lc "git diff --stat && git status --short && rg -n 'export interface VisualizationWidgetProps|settings.set|export function VisualizationWidget|export function salesData|export function monitoringData' src/VisualizationWidget.tsx src/data.ts && cat src/main.tsx"
/bin/bash -lc 'npx vitest run && git diff --check'
